basis: Q2 sales 'exceeded our expectations', with a positive comp (+0.5%) after a first half down 4.2%. Underlying profitability was at the high end of the outlook before $13.3m of tariff refunds, and the FY26 outlook was raised. Much of the raise is the refund, which is being reinvested in marketing, and underlying SG&A deleverage persists, so this is a moderate positive for a small-cap retailer.
